options.name: expose_secrets
options.description: When V(true), sensitive wireless credentials are included in the C(openwrt_wireless) fact. By default these values are redacted to prevent accidental leakage in logs or task output. When set to V(true), the task must also have an explicit C(no_log) setting (V(true) or V(false)); omitting C(no_log) is treated as an error to ensure a conscious decision is made about logging. See L(OpenWrt wireless configuration, https://openwrt.org/docs/guide-user/network/wifi/basic) for the full list of wireless
